user_query: I want to analyze the goal statistics of my favorite soccer team in the ongoing tournament, focusing on the distribution of goals scored in different minute intervals.

TaskList.description: Fetch the match schedule and results for the ongoing tournament for the specified soccer team.
Extract the goal statistics from each match retrieved in step 1, including minute of each goal scored.
Analyze the extracted goal statistics to determine the distribution of goals scored in different minute intervals.
Generate a report or visualization of the goal distribution analysis from step 3.
